title: Present Continuous и разница с Present Simple

why: Present Continuous показывает действие, которое происходит прямо сейчас или в этот период времени: «я пишу код (сейчас)». В русском для «обычно пишу» и «пишу сейчас» форма одна, а в английском — две разные: I write (обычно) и I am writing (сейчас).
formation: • Утверждение: am / is / are + V-ing. I am working. She is talking. They are waiting.
• Отрицание: am not / isn't / aren't + V-ing. He isn't working.
• Вопрос: Am / Is / Are + подлежащее + V-ing? Are you listening? What is she doing?
• Правописание -ing: make → making (e убираем), run → running (удваиваем согласную), write → writing, sit → sitting, lie → lying.
usage: 1. Действие происходит в момент речи: Be quiet! The baby is sleeping. (Тише! Ребёнок спит.)
2. Временная ситуация, «в эти дни»: I am working from home this week. (На этой неделе я работаю из дома.)
3. Изменения вокруг нас: The weather is getting colder. (Становится холоднее.)
4. Сравнение с Present Simple: She usually works from home, but today she is working in the office. (Она обычно работает дома, но сегодня работает в офисе.)
Глаголы состояния НЕ используются в Continuous: know, understand, like, love, want, need, have (иметь), believe. I know the answer. (Я знаю ответ.) I don't understand. (Я не понимаю.)
signalWords: now, right now, at the moment, today, this week, currently, Look! Listen! Для сравнения: always, usually, every day — это Present Simple.
mistakes: ✗ I am knowing the answer. → ✓ I know the answer. Know — глагол состояния, Continuous не нужен.
✗ Where you are going? → ✓ Where are you going? В вопросе am/is/are выходит перед подлежащим.
✗ They playing football now. → ✓ They are playing football now. Нельзя пропускать are.
✗ I am go to work by metro every day. → ✓ I go to work by metro every day. Привычка — Present Simple; am и V1 вместе не ставим.
✗ Are you liking this music? → ✓ Do you like this music? Like — глагол состояния.
remember: Сейчас и временно — am/is/are + -ing; всегда и обычно — Present Simple.

items.prompt: I ___ (write) code right now.
She ___ (talk) to a client at the moment.
They ___ (not work) today.
items.answer: aren't working / are not working / 're not working

items.prompt: We ___ (have) a meeting now.
He ___ (run) in the park.
___ you ___ (listen) to me?
It ___ (rain) outside.
My laptop ___ (make) a strange noise.

exercises.instruction: Выберите Present Simple или Present Continuous

items.prompt: She (a) drinks (b) is drinking tea every morning.
Be quiet! The baby (a) sleeps (b) is sleeping.
I (a) don't understand (b) am not understanding this word.
Look! It (a) snows (b) is snowing.
He usually (a) works (b) is working from home, but today he is in the office.
What (a) do you do (b) are you doing? - I'm a tester.
Right now I (a) wait (b) am waiting for a call.
They (a) have (b) are having a house in Kyiv.
Make a question: He is working now.
Make it negative: We are waiting for the bus.
items.answer: We aren't waiting for the bus. / We're not waiting for the bus. / We are not waiting for the bus.

items.prompt: Make a question: They are building a new website.
items.answer: Are they building a new website?

items.prompt: Make a question with What: You are doing something.
Make it negative: I am sitting in the office.
items.answer: I'm not sitting in the office. / I am not sitting in the office.

items.prompt: Make a question with Why: She is crying.
Make a question with Where: Tom is going somewhere.
Make it negative: The server is working.
items.answer: The server isn't working. / The server is not working.

exercises.instruction: Найдите ошибку и напишите правильное предложение

items.prompt: I am knowing the answer.
She works on a new project now.
items.answer: She is working on a new project now. / She's working on a new project now.

items.prompt: Where you are going?
He is wanting a coffee.
They playing football now.
items.answer: They are playing football now. / They're playing football now.

items.prompt: I am go to work by metro every day.
items.answer: I go to work by metro every day.

items.prompt: Are you liking this music?
It rains now, take an umbrella.
items.answer: It is raining now, take an umbrella. / It's raining now, take an umbrella.

items.prompt: Я сейчас пишу код.
items.answer: I am writing code now. / I'm writing code now. / I'm writing code right now. / I am writing code right now.

items.prompt: Что ты делаешь?
Она обычно работает из дома, но сегодня она в офисе.
items.answer: She usually works from home, but today she is in the office. / She usually works from home, but today she's at the office. / She usually works from home, but today she is working in the office.

items.prompt: Идёт дождь.
Я не понимаю этот вопрос.
items.answer: I don't understand this question. / I do not understand this question.

items.prompt: Мы ждём клиента.
items.answer: We are waiting for a client. / We're waiting for a client. / We are waiting for the client. / We're waiting for the client.

items.prompt: Куда ты идёшь?
Он сейчас не работает над этой задачей.
items.answer: He isn't working on this task now. / He's not working on this task now. / He isn't working on this task right now. / He's not working on this task right now.
